title: Explicit Hamiltonian ball packings in every dimension
description:
Version 1.2.0. Series overview, four papers, supplements, a Lean 4 formalisation and two accompanying programs (plus a separately labelled experimental archive), by Liang Song.

Overview (paper/overview): reader's guide to the division of labour, principal statements, dependencies, and verification layers. Paper I (equal balls in the four-ball): uniformly for every integer k ≥ 10 (including all non-square values) and every ε ∈ (0,1), one explicit smooth compactly supported Hamiltonian whose time-one map packs the k closed unit balls in the four-ball of radius (k/(1-ε/4))1/4, with density 1-ε/4, an explicit stability margin, and uniform perturbed fixed-step RK4 target containment, without J-holomorphic curves or Seiberg–Witten theory. Paper II (general capacities and higher dimensions): one explicit smooth Hamiltonian for all admissible data, realising in dimension four every packing with Σci2 < C2, 3ci < C (proving Biran's full-packing theorem for k ≥ 9 equal balls), and in dimensions 2n ≥ 6 every packing allowed by the volume and two-ball inequalities; plus a uniform terminating algorithm outputting a rational polynomial times a fixed cutoff. Paper III (elementary packings of the four-ball and their limits): n(n+1) balls at density 1-1/(2n+1)2, density ≥ 1-1/√k for every k, ten balls at 360/361, and three obstructions explaining the density limits of lattice, balanced-profile, and 8-column constructions. Paper IV (closed-form symplectic packings of the four-ball by equal balls): complete exact-real proof for a directly evaluable ODE-free C4 symplectic embedding chain, exact-real non-membership left inverse certificates, and a radial–Alexander generator formula in terms of a normalised primitive and abstract ODE trajectory certificates for all k ≥ 10 and ε ∈ (0,1).

The main theorems of Papers I and II, perturbed fixed-step RK4 containment, and Picard–Lindelöf trajectory certificates are verified in Lean 4 against a Mathlib-only specification. program/ provides two accompanying Python implementations—solution_epoch.py (fast elementary-flow Hamiltonians in Epoch's ODE format over its documented regime) and solution_embedding.py (closed-form C4 embeddings and inverses with float64 and AST-transformed 100-digit mpmath checkers)—documented in program/README.md and EPOCH.md.

Changes from 1.1.0. Adds the series overview, Lean-verified perturbed fixed-step RK4 containment (Paper I, Corollary D), and the Epoch problem guide. Expands the existing Paper IV with self-contained hypotheses and inverse-certificate proofs, a radial-collar generator formula and abstract trajectory certificates; strengthens the embedding checkers and adds source-bound numerical receipts. Preserves an explicitly experimental Hamiltonian-lift archive with known failure probes. Git tag v1.1.0 already included all four papers and both accompanying programs. The 525 Lean source files in SymplecticPacking/ and the principal geometric and computability statements remain unchanged from 1.0.1. See PROVENANCE.md.

Source and verification guide: https://github.com/s-JoL/Symplectic-Ball-Packing. License: Apache-2.0; vendored components retain their original notices.
